asleep.text: (Fast asleep. Best not to wake them.)
asleep.speaker: narrator

main.text: Hello! You're not buying apples, are you? Nobody ever is when I'm talking.

choices.text: How long have you kept the orchard?

orchard.text: Twenty years with Tobin, and his father before that. The old trees were planted by someone who liked straight lines. I've been undoing it a branch at a time.

pump.text: Tobin won't say it, but he's worried. If you can fix it, I'll owe you pie. Proper pie.
